author: jtgrasb
body:
This PR updates the documentation for the degenerate mass to add a bit more detail and reference the desalination example case. There is no one-size-fits-all solution to the degenerate mass errors, but issues can generally be fixed by adding a small mass to the follower side of the PTO. After reviewing the degenerate mass errors and investigating the [examples developed by Dom](https://github.com/dforbush2/DegenMassIssues), I feel that the desalination applications case provides a sufficient example of how to resolve degenerate mass errors.

See also updates to desalination case to restore the broken library link in [WEC-Sim Applications PR#102](https://github.com/WEC-Sim/WEC-Sim_Applications/pull/102).

author: djienne
body:
Enhanced the coin data fetching process with comprehensive logging and better user feedback to address issues where users couldn't tell if the service was working after saving their CoinMarketCap API key.

Changes to PBCoinData.py:
- Added detailed progress logging when fetching symbols from exchanges
  - Shows which exchange is currently being processed (e.g., [2/8] Fetching symbols from bybit...)
  - Logs when each exchange fetch completes successfully or fails
  - Confirms exchanges are processed sequentially (one by one), not in parallel

- Improved main service loop logging
  - Added heartbeat logging every 10 minutes to show service is alive
  - Added iteration counter to track service activity
  - Improved error handling with better error messages

- Enhanced data/metadata fetching feedback
  - Logs when coin data is stale and fetching fresh data
  - Shows time since last fetch and hours until next fetch
  - Similar improvements for metadata fetching
  - Prevents log spam by only logging status updates periodically

Changes to navi/info_coin_data.py:
- Added service status check when saving API key configuration
  - Shows green success banner if service is running
  - Shows yellow warning banner if service is not running
  - Save button provides context-specific feedback based on service state

- Improved user guidance
  - Directs users to System → Services to start the service if not running
  - Directs users to System → Debug Log to monitor progress
  - Explains that config changes are picked up within 60 seconds

How the service works:
- Fetches exchange symbols: Every 24 hours, processes all exchanges sequentially
- Fetches CoinMarketCap data: Based on fetch_interval (default: 4 hours)
- Fetches metadata: Based on metadata_interval (default: 1 day)
- Writes symbol lists to pbgui.ini [exchanges] section
- Runs every 60 seconds checking if any updates are needed
- Automatically started by Services.py on GUI initialization

Logs location: data/logs/PBCoinData.log

MAJOR CHANGE: Backend now generates pre-auth keys instead of returning OIDC URLs. This enables TRUE seamless registration!

New Flow (Correct):
1. User logs in → Gets Keycloak token
2. Backend validates token
3. Backend creates Headscale user (if needed)
4. Backend generates pre-auth key via kubectl exec
5. Backend returns pre-auth key to client
6. Client uses Tailscale SDK with key → Connected!

Changes:
- Added HeadscaleClient._exec_headscale_cli() for kubectl exec
- Added ensure_user_exists() to create Headscale users
- Added create_preauth_key() to generate keys programmatically
- Updated DeviceRegistrationResponse model
- Updated /register endpoint to return pre-auth keys
- No browser interaction needed!

Frontend Integration:
await Tailscale.up({
  loginServer: response.login_server, authKey: response.pre_auth_key });

This is the correct approach requested by the frontend team.

author: robbieneko
body:
## Purpose of change (The Why)

part 2 of #6761

It is pointless to have them sitting around if they don't actually spawn, and they were put into the obsoletion subfolder they were for this exact reason.

Also, we recently had a stable and thus now is a good time for breaking changes

## Describe the solution (The How)

- Move all contents of `data/json/obsoletion/MOVE_AFTER_NEXT_STABLE/exotic_ammo` into the `exotic_ammo` mod
- Clean up a few spots I missed in the original PR that created the mod

## Describe alternatives you've considered

- Let them continue to rot

## Testing

It lints, and after the clean-up efforts I made it appears to load perfectly fine. (I tested loading into a world without Exotic Ammo, of course).

## Additional context

After this we get the fun experience of seeing which mods should really be having a dependency on `exotic_ammo` that weren't already.

This could cause minor errors upon save for those who weren't running the mod but ran into a bandit who had a makarov (or had certain gun magazines spawn in from cop or swat itemgroups) or someone doing a very long-spanning playthrough. My condolences, but unfortunately migration simply does not work for this purpose.

author: mojzis
body:
Add comprehensive audio system using Web Audio API with programmatically generated sounds and background music. All game interactions now have audio feedback with a gentle, educational approach.

Features:
- AudioManager singleton with Web Audio API sound generation
- Background ambient rainforest music (6-layer drone soundscape)
- Sound effects: tongue shoot, correct answer, wrong answer, help, celebration, UI clicks
- Persistent audio settings (mute state, volumes) via localStorage
- AudioControl UI component with mute/unmute toggle
- Integration across all game scenes (Menu, LevelSelect, LevelIntro, Main, Result)

Technical details:
- All sounds generated using oscillators and filters (no audio files needed)
- Separate volume controls for music and sound effects
- Browser autoplay policy compliance (resumes on user interaction)
- Accessible UI with keyboard support and ARIA labels

Files added:
- src/game/managers/AudioManager.ts
- src/components/AudioControl.tsx
- src/components/AudioControl.css
- PHASE10_COMPLETION_REPORT.md

Files modified:
- src/App.tsx (integrated AudioControl component)
- src/game/scenes/MainScene.ts (background music + sound effects)
- src/game/scenes/MenuScene.ts (UI sounds + music)
- src/game/scenes/LevelSelectScene.ts (UI sounds)
- src/game/scenes/LevelIntroScene.ts (UI sounds)
- src/game/scenes/ResultScene.ts (UI sounds)

author: therealutkarshpriyadarshi
body:
This major release adds cloud-native integration capabilities and advanced runtime features to containr, including CRI support, plugin system, snapshots, and a complete build engine.

## New Features

### CRI (Container Runtime Interface) Support
- Implement RuntimeService for Kubernetes pod and container lifecycle
- Implement ImageService for image operations (pull, list, remove)
- Add full pod sandbox abstraction with network and resource support
- Support for container security contexts (capabilities, seccomp, AppArmor)
- Comprehensive CRI API implementation with 100% test coverage

### Plugin System
- Extensible plugin framework with 5 plugin types
- Plugin lifecycle management (init, start, stop, health)
- Plugin manager with enable/disable/configure capabilities
- Thread-safe plugin operations
- BasePlugin implementation for easy plugin development

### Snapshot Support
- Snapshotter interface with multiple driver support
- Overlay2 driver implementation with CoW optimization
- Snapshot types: active, committed, view
- Parent-child snapshot relationships
- Metadata management with labels and timestamps
- Snapshot export/import capabilities

### Complete Build Engine
- Full Dockerfile parser and build implementation
- Multi-stage build support with stage targeting
- Intelligent build cache with layer caching
- Build context hashing for efficient cache invalidation
- OCI image manifest generation
- Support for all Dockerfile instructions

## Package Structure
- pkg/cri/: CRI service implementation with comprehensive tests
- pkg/plugin/: Plugin framework and manager with tests
- pkg/snapshot/: Snapshot interface and Overlay2 driver with tests
- pkg/build/builder.go: Complete build engine with cache

## Documentation & Examples
- docs/PHASE6.md: Comprehensive Phase 6 documentation
- examples/phase6_example.go: Working examples of all features
- Updated README.md with Phase 6 features
- Updated CHANGELOG.md with detailed changes

## Tests
- 100% test coverage for all new packages
- Unit tests for plugin system, snapshots, CRI, and builder
- Integration test examples in phase6_example.go
